name: Fenwick Last Mile
description: Electric-van parcel delivery company in the fictional city of Ossington.

items.title: Delivery time slots
items.content: Customers can choose slots of 90 minutes between 07:40 and 21:20; Saturday slots cost $3.25 extra. Info FLM-SLOT-1.

items.title: Published emissions figures
items.content: Fenwick's 2025 report shows 148 electric vans and 0.07 kg CO2 per parcel. Report FLM-ESG-25.

items.title: Van charging rota
items.content: Vans plug into chargers 1 to 36 by 20:10; overnight charging is checked by Kemal Aydin at 02:30. Rota FLM-CHG-36.

items.title: Driver scanning targets
items.content: Drivers should scan 118 parcels per shift with a first-time delivery rate of 93.4%. Targets FLM-TGT-118.

items.title: Battery supplier dispute
items.content: Fenwick is withholding $940,000 from Voltrane Cells over battery packs that lose 21.6% capacity in a year; arbitration starts 2027-02-03. File FLM-ARB-0203-V.

items.title: Planned redundancies
items.content: Route optimisation will cut 27 driver roles from 2027-01-11; selection uses the 2026 scorecards. Plan FLM-HR-0111-R.
